subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question:
Sundarbons is one of the mangrove forests in the world. The forest is being damaged by a group of unscrupulous wood traders. As a result, many wild animals are on the verge of extinction, including the world's best animals, the Royal Bengal Tiger. Also toxic waste from mills and polythene pose a serious threat to this forest. Environmentalists have now become conscious to protect the Sundarbons. Observing this scene, a famous researcher of Bangladesh commented, the word of Muhammad (Sm) about the planting and maintenance of it must be remarkable. On the other hand, another thinker said, all creation belong to Allah. "So, the most beloved to Allah is that person who shows favour to the creation of Allah."
Lessons 15 & 17
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is Fili Hadith?","marks":1,"answer":"The Hadith which describes or presents an action or deed of the Holy Prophet (Sm) is called Fili Hadith."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Sunnah or Hadith is complementary to Al-Quran — Explain and write.","marks":2,"answer":"As the rules and regulations mentioned in Al-Quran are explained in Hadith, Hadith is called the complementary of Al-Quran. Allah the Most High has narrated the various commands and prohibitions, rules and regulations, and the principles of Shariah in the Quran briefly. Then Rasulullah (Sm) has provided necessary explanations of rules and regulations of Al-Quran clearly at Allah's instruction. That is, in Hadith, clear description of Al-Quran is provided."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Explain that message of Muhammad (Sm) indicated by the first researcher.","marks":3,"answer":"The first researcher indicated the message of the Hadith of Prophet (Sm) on plantation. In the Hadith related to plantation, the Holy Prophet (Sm) said, \"If a Muslim plants a sapling (tree) or grows any crop, and if some birds, men or animals eat a portion from that, then it will be counted as charity on his behalf\" (Bukhari and Muslim). The first researcher indicated towards this message of Prophet (Sm). This Hadith encourages planting trees and caring for the environment, as it brings continuous reward (Sadaqah Jariyah) when any creature benefits from it. The protection of forests like the Sundarbans aligns with this prophetic teaching."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"The statement of second thinker is similar to which subject of your textbook? Analyze how its teaching can impact your life.","marks":4,"answer":"The statement of the second thinker is similar to the subject of \"Philanthropy and Service to the Created Beings\" (Makhluq kee Khidmat) in the textbook. The teaching is that all creation is the family of Allah, and the most beloved to Allah is the one who is most beneficial to His creation. This teaching can profoundly impact my life by instilling a sense of universal responsibility and compassion. It would encourage me to:\nBy internalizing this teaching, my life would be guided by empathy, environmental consciousness, and proactive service, seeking the pleasure of Allah through benevolence to all His creation.\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question:
Hasan member works for the welfare of people of his respective area. He plants variety of trees in the both side of the road. On the other hand, his friend is a rich person. He does not pay the rights of his relatives and not do any welfare activities for the destitute. Moreover he expels out the beggers from his house if asked something.
Lessons 7 & 15 [1766933206076]
parts:
[{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is called ‘Marfu Hadith’?","marks":1,"answer":"The Hadith of which the Sanad or chain of narrators reached upto Rasulullah (Sm), is called ‘Marfu Hadith’."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"“Surely we have created man in the best form.” — Explain.","marks":2,"answer":"“Surely we have created man in the best form” - this is the fourth ayat of Sura At-Tin of the Holy Quran. In this ayat, Allah has described about the shape and nature of human beings. Allah declared human beings as the best of creatures by creating them in beautiful structure. In the earth, the structure of human is the most beautiful one. Thus, the activities of human should be the best. But, if they do evil deeds then Allah will humiliate them in world and the Akhirat and punish them."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Teaching of which Hadith is reflected by the activities of Hasan member? Explain.","marks":3,"answer":"In the activities of Hasan member, the teaching of Hadith related to plantation has been reflected. Similar to the Creative Question-Answer No. 7(c).
Complete Answer from text:
In the activities of Hasan member, the teaching of Hadith related to plantation has been reflected. The Holy Prophet (Sm) said, "If a Muslim plants a sapling (tree) or grows any crop, and if some birds, men or animals eat a portion from that, then it will be counted as charity on his behalf." (Bukhari and Muslim). Hasan member plants variety of trees on both sides of the road for public welfare, which brings benefit to people, animals, and the environment. This act is a practical implementation of this Hadith and is considered a continuous charity (Sadaqah Jariyah)."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Analyze the activities of the friend of Hasan member after identifying his activities is opposite of the teaching of which Sura of the Al-Quran.","marks":4,"answer":"The activities of the friend of Mr. Hasan is against the teachings of Sura Ad-Duha. One of the main topic of the teachings of Sura Ad-Duha is: The rich and affluent people should do good for the poor and distressed people, orphans and beggers. Not to be harsh on needy, petitioner and orphans. They must not be rebuked, beaten and threatened. Rather they should be well treated. But, in the works of friend of Hasan, opposite picture of this is expressed. The friend of Hasan of the stem does not pay the rights of his relatives. He does not help the poor and destitutes. Moreover, he expels out beggers from his house. But, in Sura Ad-Duha, it is said, Allah saves his dear slaves from all dangers and grants them a blissful life. Besides, he provides them many blessings. For this, as the gratitude for these blessings, rich and solvent persons should help and cooperate with poor, needy, orphan and beggars as much as possible. They should not be harsh towards needy and orphans asking for help, they should not be scolded or beaten rather good behaviour should be done with them. Thus, the friend's behaviour is directly opposite to the teachings of Sura Ad-Duha.
---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question:
Akbar Ali always talks about Islam. But he does not say his prayer on time. When his neighbours ask him to borrow household items, he does not want to give them. On the other hand, Noman miah is a low income person. Even in the midst of hardship, if he finds time, he devotes himself to worship Allah. He believes, "with suffering there is definitely relief".
Lessons 8 & 10 [1766933206549]
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is Hajj?","marks":1,"answer":"The visit to Baitullah (Kaba, House of Allah) and the places connected thereto on the fixed days in the fixed method in the month of Zil Hajj with the intention of pleasing Allah is called Hajj."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"\"Pay the worker before his sweat dries\". Explain it.","marks":2,"answer":"Wages are the right of workers and hence must be paid on time. In Islam, no one's work is belittled. Everyone's work is valued. Islam does not approve of any discrimination between the master and the worker in respect of every matter, including food, dress, etc. It is ruled in Islam to behave well with the worker and give wages with fairness and on time. For this reason, Prophet (Sm.) says, \"Pay the worker his dues before his sweat dries out.\" (Ibn Majah)"},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Explain the teachings of the Sura to which Akbar Ali's actions correspond.","marks":3,"answer":"Akbar Ali's actions are similar to the Kafir and Munafigs mentioned in Sura Al-Maun. Kafirs and Munafigs are great enemies of Islam. They show duplicity to fool Muslims. Also, they are reluctant to help human beings. Such behaviors are mentioned in Sura Al-Maun. These are also visible in Akbar. Akbar always talks about Islam. However, he does not perform Salat on time. Besides, he does not lend his neighbours his household items. Such an act is similar to the Kafirs and Munafigs stated in Sura Al-Maun. In this Sura, we have numerous teachings for us. For example, it is Kafirs and Munafigs who disbelieve in the Day of Judgment. It is not permissible. The orphans and distressed are not to be warded off; rather, they should be helped and supported as far as possible. All members of one's family—kith and kin, friends and comrades, neighbors—should be encouraged to help. Besides, Salat cannot be neglected. It should not be intended for making a show. Rather, Salat should be performed with the purest intention only for the pleasure of Allah the Most High. Because when a person shows indifference to Salat, there awaits perdition. Therefore, it can be said that Akbar Ali's activities are portrayed in Sura Al-Maun."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Analyze Noman's teachings by identifying which Sura's teachings are reflected in his actions.","marks":4,"answer":"In Noman Miah's actions, the teachings of Sura Al-Inshirah are reflected. Upon receiving prophethood, Rasulullah (Sm.) began to preach Islam among the Arabs. They tried a number of ways to resist him. They continued to oppose him. As a result, the Muslims became extremely irritated by their oppression and torture. In such circumstances, Sura Al-Inshirah was revealed as a consolation. In this Sura, Allah the Most High says, “Certainly with hardship goes comfort”. This ayat was revealed to console the Prophet (Sm.) when he was facing severe hardships from the non-believers. Noman Miah, despite being in financial hardship, devotes himself to worship and believes in the relief after suffering. This belief and practice directly reflect the core teaching of Sura Al-Inshirah – that with every difficulty, Allah provides ease, and one should remain patient and steadfast in worship.\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question:
Mr. Akram is a poor man. He planted palm trees on both sides of the only road leading out of his village for about four kilometers. He takes care of the plants regularly. At present the seedlings are very big. Now visitors throng there to enjoy the beauty of that road. Everyone thanks him. On the other hand, his neighbour Mr. Rafiq is a rich trader. He has been doing business with integrity for a long time following the rules of Islam. He refrains from adulterating food.
Lesson 15 & 19 [1766933207099]
parts:
[{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"Define Sunnah?","marks":1,"answer":"The sayings, deeds, practices, traditions as well as conventions approved by the holy Prophet (Sm) are called the Sunnah."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Why is the 3rd Hijri century called the Golden Age of Hadith compilation? Explain.","marks":2,"answer":"In the third Hijri century, many Hadith books were compiled. Hence, this century is called the golden era of Hadith compilation. The sayings, deeds and tacit approvals of Prophet (Sm) are called Hadith. The preservation of Hadith began in Rasulullah’s (Sm) life time but collective compilation of Hadith did not start. During the Umayyad Khilafat, Hazrat Umar Ibn Abdul Aziz (Ra) first took the initiatives to compile Hadiths. Later in the third Hijri century, the six most authentic books of Hadith were compiled. These are collectively called ‘Al-Sihah-Al Sittah’ or the six authentic Hadith books. As these main books of Hadiths were compiled in the third Hijri century, this century is called golden era of Hadith compilation."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Which Hadith in the textbook is related to the activities of Mr. Akram? Explain","marks":3,"answer":"The Hadith on plantation of textbook is related with the activities of Mr. Akram. Similar to the Creative Question-Answer No. 7(c).
Complete Answer from text:
The Hadith on plantation of textbook is related with the activities of Mr. Akram. In the Hadith related to plantation, the Holy Prophet (Sm) said, "If a Muslim plants a sapling (tree) or grows any crop, and if some birds, men or animals eat a portion from that, then it will be counted as charity on his behalf" (Bukhari and Muslim). Mr. Akram planted palm trees on both sides of the road and takes care of them. Visitors enjoy the beauty and benefits. This aligns with the Hadith where planting trees that benefit others (birds, men, animals) is counted as continuous charity (Sadaqah Jariyah)."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Analyze the work of Mr. Rafiq in the light of the hadith in the textbook.","marks":4,"answer":"In the activities of Mr. Rafiq, the matters of the Hadith on honesty in business of the textbook is reflected. Business and commerce are a noble profession. Honest businesses command high esteem both in the world and life hereafter. Honest businesses do not provide less in weight, do not adulterate commodity and deceive people and they conduct business by following the rules and regulations of Islam. In the activities of Mr. Rafiq, such qualities are expressed. Mr. Rafiq is a rice trader. He has been doing business with integrity for a long time following the rules of Islam. He refrains from adulterating food and deception. In this activity of him, the quality of maintaining honesty in business is reflected. The honest businessmen will command high esteem both here and hereafter. Rasulullah (Sm) said, ‘On the Day of Resurrection, an honest and trustworthy businessman will be in the company of the martyrs’ (Ibn Majah). On that day, there will be no fear or anxiety for them. Rather on that day, they will be blessed with the favours of Allah. They will also enter paradise like the martyrs. From the above discussions, it can be understood that, in the activities of Mr. Rafiq, the matter of maintaining honesty in business has been reflected. That is why, we should conduct business with honesty and trustworthiness.
---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question:
Mr. Hedayet is a famous industrialist of Bangladesh. He leads a very simple life. When he finds the orphans and the helpless people, he patted them on the head and help them as much as possible. And never speaks to them in a threatening tone. His wife Sultana is very careful about her family. If a neighbour woman wants help with any household items, she helps her.
Lessons 7 & 10 [1766933207494]
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is Qawli Hadith?","marks":1,"answer":"The Hadith orally presented by Rasulullah (Sm) are called Qawli Hadith."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Why is the Tilawat of the Quran called the best Ibadat? Explain.","marks":2,"answer":"Tilawat of the Quran is called the best Ibadat because it ensures the earthly benefit and success in Akhirat. Al-Quran is the holy message of Allah the Almighty. It is a special blessing of Allah for human. It increases the dignity of its recitors. Through reciting this, people can gain satisfaction and nearness of Allah. Through reciting the holy Quran properly, people can gain success in earth and Akhirat. And for this Prophet (Sm) said, \"The best worship for my followers is the recitation of Al-Quran\". (Baihaqi)"},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"The teachings of which Sura of the Holy Quran has been revealed in the behaviour of the industrialist in the stem? Explain.","marks":3,"answer":"The teaching of Sura Ad-Duha of the holy Quran has been revealed in the behaviour of the industrialist mentioned in the stem. One of the main thing among the teachings of Sura Ad-Duha is that the rich should do good for the poor and distressed people, orphans and beggars. Not to be harsh on the needy, petitioners and orphans. They must not be rebuked, scolded, beaten or threatened. Rather they should be well treated. These teachings of Sura Ad-duha are revealed by the behaviour of the industrialist of the stem. The industrialist mentioned in the stem leads a very simple life. When he finds the orphans and helpless people, he patted them on the head and helps them as much as possible. He never speaks to them in a threatening tone. Through these behaviours of him, the teachings of Sura Ad-Duha is expressed. In the 10th verse of this Sura it is said, \"And scold not the petitioner\". We get the teaching of not being harsh over poor, petitioner, beggars and helping them from this. So, in the behaviour of the industrialist mentioned in the stem, the teachings of Sura Ad-Duha is reflected."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"The teaching of which Sura of your textbook is reflected in Mrs. Sultana's activities? Analyze.","marks":4,"answer":"In the activities of Mrs. Sultana, the teaching of Sura Al-Maun of my textbook is reflected. The description of some of the special characteristics of Munafiqs has been provided in the 107th Sura of Al-Quran, Sura Al-Maun. Among which one is not providing the household objects to others. Such characteristics is not expressed in the activities of Mrs. Sultana rather good activity is expressed. Mrs. Sultana of the stem is very careful about her family. If a neighbor woman wants help with any household items, she helps her. She mainly helps and cooperates because of the teachings of Surah Al-Maun. Because the teaching of this Sura is- little items of household like chopper, knife, oil, salt etc should be provided to others rather than showing parsimony. Those who does such, Allah declared misery for them. And those who will lead life according to the instructions of Allah, the place of peace, Jamai is kept for them. From the above discussion, Mrs. Sultana's activities reflected the teaching of Sura Al-Maun of my textbook. That is why we should conduct our life by following the orders of Allah. [Subject: Islamic Studies]\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question: The fish farm of Mr. Amin has swept away by flood water. As a result, he suffered a lot financially. But he has not been disappointed. He has started working with a new zeal. On the other hand, his friend Mr. Helal is a businessman. He does not adulterate the products. He sells the products in fair price. Knowing about him, an Islamic scholar said, "This type of businessman will get great reward in the day of Qiyamat." Lessons 19 & 20 [1766933207624]
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is Nazira Tilawat?","marks":1,"answer":"The visual recitation of Al-Quran is called Nazira Tilawat."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Why is Islam called a dynamic code of life?","marks":2,"answer":"Islam is called a dynamic code of life because there is specific instruction in Islam about new problems of the continuously changeable society. Islam is the religion or code of life provided by Allah the Most High. This is a complete code of life. The direction of all the problems of human life is provided in this. The laws of solving newly originated problems of the society changing with time are available in Islam. If the solution of any newly originated problem is not found directly in Al-Quran and Hadith, then the problem can be solved by according to Jima and Qiyas. For these reasons, Islam is called a dynamic code of life."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Which Hadith's teachings are reflected in the character of Mr. Amin? Explain.","marks":3,"answer":"The teachings of the Hadith related to Patience and Forbearance is reflected in the behaviour of Mr. Amin. Prophet (Sm) said about patience and forbearance, \"A Mumin's every deed is amazing. And each deed brings him well being and good. And none but a Mumin can get it. When he enjoys happiness and peace, he expresses gratitude. It is good for him. And if he suffers sorrows and pain, he adopts patience. This too is good for him.\" (Muslim). The teaching of this Hadith is expressed in the behaviour of Mr. Amin. Mr. Amin of the stem is a fish farmer. His fish farm has swept away by flood water. As a result, he suffered a lot financially. But, he has not been disappointed. Rather he has started working in a new zeal by depending on Allah. From this incident, it can be understood that, Mr. Amin has taken lesson from the Hadith related to patience and forbearance. Because, this Hadith teaches that both happiness and sorrow is beneficial for Mumin. That is why, one must not despair at the time of sorrow and pains. Rather, one must obey the commands of Allah with patience."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Justify the statement of the Islamic scholar in light of the related Hadith of your textbook.","marks":4,"answer":"The statement of the Islamic scholar about honest businessman Mr. Helal is accurate in the light of the Hadith related to honesty in business. Business and commerce are a noble profession. Our beloved Prophet (Sm) too was a businessman. An honest and trustworthy businessman commands high esteem both here and the hereafter. Mr. Helal is also an honest businessman. He will also gain this esteem. Mr. Helal of the stem is a big businessman. He does not adulterate the products despite having the opportunity. He sells the products in fair price. Knowing about him, an Islamic scholar said, \"This type of businessman will get great reward in the day of Qiyamat\". Here, the Islamic scholar talked about the prize set for honest businessman. Because, in the day of Qiyamat, the trustworthy and truthful businessmen will become companions of the martyrs. Rasulullah (Sm) has said about this, \"A trustworthy, truthful businessman will be in the company of the martyrs on the Qiyamat Day\". (Ibn Majah) After the above discussion, it can be said that Mr. Helal is an honest businessman. The statement of the Islamic scholar about reward of honest businessman on the day of Qiyamat is correct. That is why, all of us should try to be trustworthy and truthful in business.\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question: Mr. Sadik reads some Suras in the morning where the principle of personal domestic, social, cultural and economic activities were described. At the time of lunch, while discussing the teaching of his read Suras, he said to his elder son, "My son! Allah remove your wants and gifted you solvency. So, you will take care of the poor and orphans and do not neglect the people who ask for help." [1766933208099]
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is \"Shan-i-Nuzul\"?","marks":0,"answer":"The cause or background of the revelation of the Sura or Ayat of Al-Quran is called 'Shan-i-Nuzul'."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"\"Recite the Quran slowly and clearly.\" — Explain.","marks":2,"answer":"Allah Ta’ala has revealed the mentioned verse by instructions to recite the Quran with Tazbid. Al-Quran should be studied with understanding, reflection,and research. Alongside reflection and research, it is very necessary to read the Quran correctly and nicely. An incorrect and unimpressive recitation of Al-Quran brings sin with it. The method of correct and nice recitation of Al-Quran is termed as Tazbid. Allah Ta’ala said about recitation of Quran with Tazbid, \"Recite the Quran slowly and clearly\" (Sura Al-Muzammil, Ayat 4)."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"What type of Sura did Mr. Sadik recite? Explain.","marks":3,"answer":"Mr. Sadik has recited the Madani Surahs of Al-Quran. Al-Quran is divided into 30 parts in total. There are 114 suras in Al-Quran. Considering the time of revelation, the suras of Al-Quran are divided into 2 groups. Such as- Makki and Madani. The suras revealed in Madinah are the Madani Suras. In Madani suras the principles of worshipping Allah, Salat, Sawm, Zakat, Haji, rules and regulations of Shariat, Farz, Wajib etc. are clearly mentioned. It is similar to the recited suras by Mr. Sadiq. In the stem it is mentioned that Mr. Sadiq recites some suras after waking up in the morning where a discussion related to the regulations of Salat, Zakat, and Haji are mentioned. Here, mainly Madani suras are being mentioned. In these suras the principles of Ibadat, Salat, Zakat, Haji, Sawm etc. have been described. The rules and regulations of Shariat, Farz, Wajib, etc. are clearly mentioned in them. Besides, introduction of Nifaq and conspiracies of the Munafiqs are mentioned. Personal, domestic, social, national, internal, educational and cultural principles have been described in these suras. The laws and regulations in respect of family transactions, inheritance, commerce and business, buying and selling and such other economic activities are described as well. Judicial matters, penal code, Jihad, code of laws, diplomatic policy etc. have been discussed in them. That is why it can be said that the suras that Mr. Sadik has recited are the Madani suras."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Evaluate the advice of Mr. Sadik in the light of the relevant Sura of text book.","marks":4,"answer":"The advice of Mr.Sadik to his son is proper in the light of Sura Ad-Duha. Sura Ad-Duha is the 93rd Sura of Al-Quran. In this Sura Allah the Most High has narrated numerous favours given to the Holy Prophet Hazrat Muhammad (Sm). Again, He also commands Rasul (Sm) to express his gratitude. The teachings of this Sura is reflected in the stem. In the stem the advice given by Mr. Sadik to his elder son is proper in the light of Sura Ad-Duha. Because, we get this lesson from Sura Ad-Duha. Here, it is told that Allah saves His dear slaves from danger and calamities, He grants them blissful life. Besides, He provides them many blessings. For this, as the gratitude for these blessings, rich and solvent persons should help and cooperate with poor, needy, orphan and beggars as much as possible. They should not be harsh towards needy and orphans asking for help, they should not be scolded or beaten rather good behaviour should be done with them. Lastly, it can be said that, Mr. Sadik has provided correct advice to his son in the light of Sura Ad-Duha. And all of us should implement the teachings of Sura Ad-Duha in our life.\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question:
Mahzabin is a very beautiful woman. Seeing her beauty her sister-in- law Tabassum said, "Allah has created human beings with the nice structure. So we should abide by the commands of Him". On the other hand, Sultana accomplishes all of her familial duties but gives nothing to the needy people when they want something to her. She does not help neighbours when they ask her for household necessities.
Lessons 9 & 10 [1766933209063]
parts:
[{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is 'Shan-i-Nuzul'?","marks":1,"answer":"The cause or background of the revelation of the Sura or Ayat of Al-Quran is called 'Shan-i-Nuzul'."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Why is Hazrat Usman called 'Jamiul Quran'? Explain.","marks":2,"answer":"Hazrat Uthman (Ra.) is called Jamiul Quran for fulfilling the responsibility of compiling the Quran. There arose some differences in the recitation of Al-Quran during the Khilafat of Hazrat Uthman (Ra.). For this, there was a chance of confusion. Realizing this matter, he collected copies of different tribal styles, kept the pure one and burned the other copies in agreement with other Sahabis. In this way, Al-Quran was compiled under his direct supervision. For this great and noble contribution, Hazrat Uthman (Ra.) is called 'Jamiul Quran' or 'Gatherer' or 'Compiler' of Al-Quran."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Tabassum's comment is related to which sura of your textbook? Explain the teaching of that sura.","marks":3,"answer":"Tabassum's comment is related to the Sura At-Tin in the textbook. Similar to the Creative Question-Answer No. 6(c).
Complete Answer from text:
Tabassum's comment is related to the Sura At-Tin in the textbook. Sura At-Tin is the 95th Sura of the Holy Quran. In this Sura, Allah declares that He has created human beings in the best of forms (the finest stature). Tabassum's statement that "Allah has created human beings with the nice structure" directly reflects the message of verse 4 of this Sura. The teaching of Sura At-Tin is that while Allah has honoured humans with the best physical and spiritual form, this honour is contingent upon faith and righteous deeds. If humans neglect Allah's commands and engage in evil, they will be degraded to the lowest of the low, both in this world and the hereafter. Thus, the Sura connects physical perfection with moral and spiritual responsibility."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Sultana's activities are similar to the subject matter of which sura of your textbook? Identify it and explain its significance.","marks":4,"answer":"Sultana's activities are similar to the subject matter of Sura Al-Maun of the textbook. Sura Al-Maun describes the characteristics of the hypocrites (Munafiqun). One of these characteristics is refusing to give even small acts of kindness or lending household items to those in need. Sultana, despite fulfilling her core family duties, refuses to help neighbours with household necessities. This behaviour mirrors the attitude condemned in Sura Al-Maun. The significance of this Sura is that it exposes the hypocrisy of those who may perform some religious or social duties but lack basic compassion and refuse minor assistance to others. It teaches that true faith is reflected in generosity, especially in small, everyday matters, and that miserliness in these areas is a sign of hypocrisy that leads to divine punishment.
---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question: Scenario-1: Miss. Rahela Omar, from Somalia, was chosen by the judges as the first Hijab Miss world-2022 considering body structure, size, shape personality etc. Scenario-2: On the occasion of the wedding ceremony when the bridegroom came to see the daughter of a labour Mr. Motin, he asked for a dozen ceramic plates, ten glasses and two juges to Mr. Sobur's wife. Although she offers her five times salat in an inattentive mind but she provides those house hold petty articles. [1766933210177]
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is 'Sunnah'?","marks":1,"answer":"The sayings, deeds, practice and conventions approved by the Holy Prophet (Sm.) are called the Sunnah."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"How has Allah, the Almighty preserved Al-Quran? Explain.","marks":2,"answer":"Allah, the Almighty has preserved Al-Quran at Lao-hi-Mahfuz. Lao-hi-Mahfuz is the protected tablet. Allah the Most High says about this, \"Indeed it is the holy Quran which has been inscribed on the protected plate.\" (Sura: Al-Buruj, Ayats 21-22). The complete code of life and direction for all men to come till the Qiyamat are available in Al-Quran. So, its preservation is necessary. Allah the Most Great has assumed the responsibility of its protection. He announces thus, \"It is we who have revealed the Quran and surely we are its protector.\" (Sura: Al-Hijr, Ayat: 9)."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Which Sura's teaching is manifested in scenario-1? Explain it.","marks":3,"answer":"The teaching of Sura At-Tin is manifested in scenario-1. Sura At-Tin is the 95th Sura of Al-Quran. In this Sura, human are declared as the best and most beautiful among all creations. In this Sura, Allah has described about the shape and nature of human which is expressed in scenario-1. In scenario-1, Miss Rahela Omar was chosen as the first Hijab Miss World-2022 considering body structure, size, shape, personality etc. This incident of scenario-1 reflects the beautiful shape and creation of human described in Sura At-Tin. The teaching of this sura is that though human are the most beautiful creation of world, if they do not perform good deeds, they will be held accountable by Allah in earth and Akhirai and will be punished severely. So, everyone should not show pride and perform all principles of Islam properly."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Do you think that the activities of Mr. Sobur's wife shown in scenario-2 are accurate? Evaluate it in the light of your text book.","marks":4,"answer":"No, the activities of Mr. Sobur’s wife shown in scenario-2 are not accurate in the light of Sura Al-Maun. Sura Al-Maun is the 107th sura of Al-Quran. Allah Ta’ala has described some characteristics of Munafiqs in this sura. Among these, two special features of Munafiqs are that they are indifferent to Salat and they do not give small household objects to others. In the activities of Mr. Sobur’s wife, one of these characteristics can be observed. Mr. Sobur’s wife, mentioned in scenario-2, provides small household objects to her neighbours which is an activity worth praising. But, she is inattentive towards her prayers which is similar to the characteristics of Munafiq. Because, Munafiqs are inattentive towards Salat. Sometimes, they offer prayer to show others. And for Salat performed by such class awaits sufferings and severe punishment. So, it can be said that, Mr. Sobur’s wife need to be careful in offering prayers according to the teaching of Sura Al-Maun. Rather than offering prayer for showing others and inattentively, she will have to pray with faithfulness and sincerity.\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question:

As Sajid calls upon the youths of the locality to speak the truth and offer Salat (Prayer) on time, some youths speak ill of him on hearing his call. As the harassment of the youths became intolerable, he takes shelter with his teacher, who recites the following Ayat of Al-Quran—
Lesson 8 & 10 [1766933210246]
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is the meaning of the word ‘farghab’?","marks":1,"answer":"Farghab means pay attention or be inclined."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Explain the statement—‘We have created man in the nicest shape’.","marks":2,"answer":"‘We have created man in the nicest shape’- this is the meaning of the fourth Ayat of Sura At-Tin. Allah proclaims to have created man in the best of shapes. The shape of man is the most excellent among all created things and beings. But if man does not perform good acts and indulges in evil deeds, Allah the Most High shall humiliate him both in here and the hereafter and subject him to severe punishment."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Explain whose features have come out from Sajib’s activity.","marks":3,"answer":"Sajib does not perform Salat regularly and timely. The marks of Munafiq has come out by the activities of Sajib. To be inattentive in Salat, not to perform Salat in time etc. are behaviour of a Munafiq. Such people are indifferent to Salat and only make a show of their Salat to the Muslims. They do not care about the importance and merits of Salat. Allah, the Most High has said about that in Sura Maun. He said, “Then woe to the prayer offers. For they are in attentive to it. Who make a show of their Salat.” After the discussion above it can be said that because of not performing Salat timely and regularly, the characteristics of Munafiqs have been revealed in Sajib."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Identify Sajid’s activities and analysis them in the light of lessons in your textbook.","marks":4,"answer":"The activities of Sajid reflect his call towards the right path. Such behaviour is correct according to the teachings of Sura Al-Inshirah. Allah the Most High has ordered human beings to stay in and call others to the path of truth. During this time, different obstacles arise. The Prophet (Sm.) also suffered from ridicule and oppression while inviting people to the right path, which is also evident in Sajid’s life. Sajid has suffered from mockery and harassment from some youths when he advises them to speak the truth and offer Salat on time. When he takes shelter with his teacher, the teacher recites Ayat 5 of Sura Al-Inshirah—“Certainly with hardship goes comfort”. Allah revealed this Ayat when the Prophet was inviting people to Islam after receiving Prophethood. The Makkans caused him physical and mental pain by oppressing him and calling him a poet, fortune-teller, magician, insane, etc. Yet, the Prophet (Sm.) and his companions did not step back because Allah declared that they would enjoy peace and ease after pain and suffering. Therefore, if Sajid adopts patience in preaching Islam, he will certainly win and find comfort.\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question:
Sabir and Jaad are two friends. In the morning they were going to their school. On the way Sabri encouraged for plantation and agricultural pursuits. Jaad told him that all goods works and proper niyyat will be counted.
Lessons 12 & 15 [1766933211305]
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is Mubah?","marks":1,"answer":"Such acts are called Mubah the performance of which brings no reward as well as non-performance brings no sin."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Why recitation of the Quran is the best Ibadat?","marks":2,"answer":"Recitation of the Quran is the best Ibadat because it is a direct communion with the words of Allah. It purifies the heart, increases faith, brings immense rewards (each letter recited multiplies into ten good deeds), guides to the right path, and is a source of intercession on the Day of Judgment. The Prophet (Sm) said, \"The best of you are those who learn the Quran and teach it.\" (Bukhari) and also, \"Whoever reads one letter from the Book of Allah will have one good deed, and every good deed is multiplied ten times.\" (Tirmidhi)."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Lesson of which Hadith reflect in the advice of Sabri? Explain.","marks":3,"answer":"The lesson of the Hadith on plantation (agriculture) is reflected in Sabri's advice. The Hadith states: \"If a Muslim plants a tree or sows a seed, and then a bird, or a person, or an animal eats from it, it is counted as a charity for him.\" (Bukhari & Muslim). Sabri is encouraging plantation, which is an act that yields continuous charity (Sadaqah Jariyah) as long as any creature benefits from it, aligning perfectly with this Hadith."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"How will you evaluate the comment of Jaad? Explain in the light related Hadith.","marks":4,"answer":"Jaad's comment is correct and is supported by the fundamental Hadith on Intention (Niyyah). The Prophet (Sm) said: \"Indeed, actions are judged by intentions, and every person will have what he intended.\" (Bukhari). Jaad emphasizes that for any good work, like plantation, to be truly rewarding in the sight of Allah, it must be accompanied by a proper and sincere intention (Niyyah) to seek Allah's pleasure. Even an outwardly great deed like planting trees will only yield its full spiritual reward if done with the right intention. Therefore, Jaad's comment complements Sabri's advice by highlighting the essential internal dimension (sincerity) that must accompany the external action. subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question: Mr. Rafee planted many saplings at the two sides of public road nearby his house. Observing this, his elder son Safee said, "Why is it needed to plant trees at the public place?" He replied, "Listen my son! travelers will take shelter under these trees, birds will build nest and the other animals will also eat fruits from those trees." Advice of his father had brought a change in Safee's thinking. He resumed a kitten fallen into the pond while coming back from college and released it after taking care off. Seeing this, his uncle Tagee said, "You will also gain Allah's satisfaction due to showing kindness to a small creature." [1766933212258]
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is \"Sanad\"?","marks":1,"answer":"The (unbroken) chain of the narrators of Hadith is called Sanad."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"\"Importance of Hadith is inevitable for understanding the Quran.\" — Explain.","marks":2,"answer":"\"The importance of hadith is inevitable for understanding the Quran\" - the statement is accurate. Allah the Most High has narrated the various commands and prohibitions, rules and regulations and the principles of Shariah in the Quran briefly. Rasulullah (Sm) would impart the necessary explanation of rules and regulations of Al-Quran. In most cases he would teach them practically by practicing them himself. It is these sayings and deeds of Rasulullah (Sm) that are called Hadith. Therefore, for following the rules and regulations of Al-Quran clearly, the importance of Hadith is immense."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Implementation of which Hadith has been reflected in the activities of Mr. Rafee? Explain.","marks":3,"answer":"In the activities of Mr. Rafee, the implementation of Hadith related to plantation is noticed. Tree plantation is an act of merit. It is said in a Hadith about this, \"If a Muslim plants a sapling (tree) or grows any crop, and if some birds, men or animals eat a portion from that, then it will be counted as charity on his behalf.\" (Bukhari and Muslim) This Hadith encourages us in tree plantation. Man can get benefitted in many ways through trees. Man can earn benefit through this in the next life parallel with benefits in this life. The implementation of this Hadith is noticeable in the activities of Mr. Rafee. Mr. Rafee's thinking and activities are possible because of Hadith related to plantation. And, in the eye of Islam, his such activity can be termed as charity. Because, in Hadith, it is said, If a Muslim plants a sapling (tree) or grows any crop, it can be a reason of charity. Because, birds, animals, worms and insects feed on crops and fruits. For this, the planters and farmers get rewards. Allah the Most High gets this reward recorded in his accounts-book to the same tune as he could earn by giving that crop in charity. Thus, it can be said that, the real example of Hadith related to tree plantation exists in the activities of Mr. Rafee."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Determine the validity of the comment of uncle in regard of Safee's activities, in the light of relevant Hadith.","marks":4,"answer":"The comment of Safee's uncle in regard of his activities is valid in the light of Hadith on philanthropy and service to the created beings of the textbook. Allah the Most High is the creator of everything. Except Himself, all the rest that exist are creations or makhluq. As man is His creation, so are the insects and worms. Having mercy towards these makhluq is service to the created beings. In Safee's activity, this service is expressed. The comment of Safee's uncle is correct. Because, Allah the Most High has created everything of this universe. He is the Nourisher, Cherisher, Sustainer and Controller of everything. But, He has not created all things in an identical mould. This is a test taken by Him. He has divided the creations in various groups and species, and maintains all for the benefit of mankind. So, man should behave well with all the creations. The Holy Prophet (Sm) said, \"All created beings constitute the Family of Allah. So, the dearest to Allah is that man who favours His created beings most.\" (Baihaqi). Allah the Most High becomes pleased if kindness is shown to His creatures and loves them more. From the above discussions, it can be understood that the work of Safee is included in service to the created beings. And the comment of his uncle regarding this is also valid. Through this activity, Safee will be able to gain more love from Allah the Most High.\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question:
Mr. ‘Ka’ went to Macca with the Hajji to buy pure gold by cheap rate by the name of Haji. His son Sumon, join in a government job last month. For this he arranged food for the destitute and orphan Sumon’s friend Mr. ‘Kha’ made a negative comment and told, you have got the job by your own intellect. So, why will you feed others?
Lessons 10 & 12 [1766933212675]
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is called Sunnat-i-Zaida?","marks":1,"answer":"Those acts which are proved to have been performed by the Holy Prophet (Sm) but not always; rather, which he would do at one time but did not do at other times, are called the Sunnat-i-Zaida."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Explain the importance of Ijma.","marks":2,"answer":"The importance and necessity of Ijma in Islamic Shariat is immense. The origin of Ijma has been noticeable from the time of Rasul (Sm). Rasulullah (Sm) himself would seek advice of his companions on various issues. Allah the Most High says: “And their affairs are resolved on the basis of mutual consultation.” (Sura: Sura, Ayat, 38). In this way, Rasulullah (Sm) settle legitimacy, example and ideal of Ijma. If proper solution of any matter is not found in Quran and Hadith, for combined decision of the Mujtahids of Muslim Ummah, necessity of Ijma until Qiyamat is immense."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"The activities of Mr. ‘Ka’ is opposite of the teaching of which Hadith? Explain.","marks":3,"answer":"The activities of Mr. ‘Ka’ is opposite of the teachings of Hadith related to Niyyat or motive. The purpose or aim of the deed is called Niyyat. People will get the outcome of their doings according to their Niyyat. In the Hadith related to Niyyat, Prophet (Sm) said, “In fact, all deeds (their results) are dependent on intention” (Bukhari). In the activities of Mr. ‘Ka’, opposite of this Hadith can be seen. Mr. ‘Ka’ of the stem went for Haji but his intention was to buy pure gold by cheap rate. In such activities of Mr. ‘Ka’, he will not get any blessing, because his Niyyat is not right. The teaching of the Hadith related to Niyyat is Alongside the outward deed, Allah the Most High notices the state of the mind too. Thus, if anyone does good work in bad motive, he will still not get any blessing. That is why the precondition of any work is the purity of Niyyat. But, it is absent in the activities of Mr.‘Ka’. Hence, his work is opposite to the Hadith related to Niyyat."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Evaluate the Sumon’s activities after identifying the opinion of Mr. ‘Kha’ is opposite of the teaching of which Sura.","marks":4,"answer":"The opinion of Mr. ‘Kha’ is against the teachings of Sura Al-Maun. Sura Al-Maun is the 107th Sura of Al-Quran. In the third Ayat of this Sura, Allah said by presenting the characteristics of Munafiqs, “And does not encourage offering food to the needy”. Through this ayat, Allah has made us alert about nifaq, and ordered us to stay away from this characteristics. But, in the comment of Mr. ‘Kha’, opposite characteristics of this has been expressed. In the stem, Sumon, friend of Mr. ‘Kha’, arranges food for orphans and destitutes by the favour of government job. At this ‘Kha’ told by commenting negatively, you have got this job by your own intellect. So, why will you feed others? Such comment of ‘Kha’ is not acceptable at all. Because, Allah has ordered regarding feeding orphans and destitutes. And those who do not help the orphans and needles despite having ability and discourage others regarding this, will be counted as Munafiq. On the other hand, by arranging food for orphans and needy, Sunnan has fulfilled the responsibility of Iman. So, it can be said that, for discouraging in the works of orphan and needy, Mr. ‘Kha’ is a Munafiq. And for this, he will have to face punishment in the life after death.\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question: Mr. 'Y' plants trees every year beside the road of his village taking lesson from a Hadith of Prophet (Sm.). On the other hand Saimun is a businessman. He adulterates with good commodities by the bad one and sales in high price. One day an Imam of nearby mosque says, "A trustworthy, truthful businessman will be in the company of the martyrs on the Qiyamat Day." Lessons 14 & 18 [1766933212735]
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What do you understand by Haram?","marks":1,"answer":"The actions or things which are abominable and therefore, rejectable and discardable in pursuance of the clear directions of Al-Quran and Sunnah, are Haram."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"\"Farz-i-Kifaya\" is the combined Farz —Make it clear.","marks":2,"answer":"Farz-i-Kifaya is collective Farz. The duties that are Farz on Muslims, but if performed by a group of Muslims in the society, it will be accepted on behalf of all Muslims. The rest non performing Muslims are exempted from this obligation due to its performance by a group of Muslims. But, if any group does not perform it, all members of that society will be sinners. For example, the Janaza Salat (funeral prayer for a Muslim) etc."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Evaluate the act of 'Y'.","marks":3,"answer":"The act of Mr. 'Y' will be counted as Sadaq-e-Zariya. Plantation and agriculture are very essential for human life. Man derives much benefit from this. Prophet (Sm) said about this in Hadith, \"If a Muslim plants a sapling (tree) or grows any crop, and if some birds, men or animals eat a portion from that, then it will be counted as charity on his behalf.\" (Bukhari and Muslim) There is similarity of the description of this Hadith with the act of 'Y'. Mr 'Y' plants trees every year beside the road of his village taking lessons from a Hadith of Prophet (Sm). The activities of 'Y' are relatable to the Hadith discussed above. That is why, this act of him is termed as Sadaq (charity) in the language of Hadith. Man can earn benefit from plantation in the next life parallel with benefits in this life. For, birds, animals, worms and insects feed on crops and fruits. For this the planters and farmers get rewards. Allah the Most High gets this reward recorded in his account book to the same tune as he could earn by giving that crop in charity. As a result, he owns much reward even without himself being aware of that."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Mention the teaching of the Hadith that has been violated by Saimun regarding the business, then justify the citation of Mr. Imam.","marks":4,"answer":"Saimun violated the teaching of honesty in business that is indicated in Hadith. And the citation of Mr. Imam regarding this is correct. Businessman Saimun adulterates with good commodities by the bad ones in his shop and sales in high price. But, the Holy Prophet (Sm) has imposed two conditions in case of business. Firstly, the business must be conducted with honesty and truthfulness. Secondly, the businessmen must be faithful and trustworthy. That is, business and trade will have to be conducted with honesty and faithfulness. Men provide less in weigh being owned by greed, sells bad commodity by calling them good. They adulterate bad commodity with good ones, hide the problems in the commodity. They do many unethical works like hoarding. Saimun's activity is opposite to these conditions. The Imam's citation is from the Hadith: \"A trustworthy, truthful businessman will be in the company of the martyrs on the Qiyamat Day.\" This Hadith promises great reward for honest traders. Since Saimun violates the condition of honesty, he will not get this reward. The Imam's statement is thus a reminder of the correct Islamic business ethic.\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question:
Mr. Nasir and Mr. Zabir are two friends. Mr. Nasir has planted many fruit trees around his home. People take rest in the shade of those trees and the birds eat fruits. He gives the fruits to his neighbours. On the other hand Mr. Zabir runs a grocery shop where goods are being sold at a fair price. There is no adulteration. That is why many people buy goods from his shop in the month of Ramadan.
Lesson 15 & 19 [1766933214162]
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is called the third source of Shariat?","marks":1,"answer":"Al-Jima is called the third source of Shariat."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Why is Haram rejectable?","marks":2,"answer":"Haram means prohibited, bad, unfair, Profane. Allah the Most High has declared some things as lawful and still others as unlawful. He has forbidden those things which are harmful for mankind. So a man should abandon all that is Haram."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"How will Mr. Nasir’s work be considered? Explain in the light of Hadith.","marks":3,"answer":"It is mentioned in the stem that Mr. Nasir planted many fruit trees. As a result, people rest under these trees and birds eat the fruits. This work of Mr. Nasir is regarded as charity in the light of Shariat. Prophet (Sm.) says: “If a Muslim plants a sapling (tree) or grows any crop and if some birds, men or animal eat a portion from that, then it will be counted as charity on his behalf.” (Bukhari and Muslim) Plantation and agriculture are very essential for human life. Tree meets our food, dress, shelter, etc. for survival. In this Hadith under discussion the Holy Prophet (Sm.) has induced us to drive these bounties and benefits through plantation. So, Mr. Nasir does an honest work to plant fruit tree. It is recorded as charity in the accounts Book of the grower for hereafter."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Evaluate the result of Mr Jabir’s work in the light of Islam.","marks":4,"answer":"According to the stem, Mr. Jabir is an honest shopkeeper due to fair price and adulteration – free goods. Business and commerce are a noble profession. Our beloved Prophet (Sm) also was a tradesman. An honest and trustworthy businessman commands high esteem both here and hereafter. Rasulullah (Sm.) said, \"A trustworthy, truthful businessman will be in the company of the martyrs on the Qiyamat Day.\" Allah the Most High has promised in Al-Quran paradise for them. However, for this, traders will have to fulfil two conditions. Firstly, they must conduct their business with honesty and truthfulness. Secondly, they must be faithful and trustworthy. Then all faithful and honest businessmen will become companions of the martyrs. Both the conditions are fulfilled by Mr. Jabir. So, he will stay in Jamat with martyrs."}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question: Mr. 'M' earns a lot of money by doing good. Expecting rewards in Akhirat, he behaves with orphans, poors and relatives kindly. He does not like making a show in the Ibadat of Allah. On the other hand Mr. 'N' earns a lot of money by doing business of narcotics like heroin, yaba, phensedyl etc. knowing Haramness of his earnings, the respected Imam said, "The consequences of this type of earnings are very horrible in here and here after life." Lessons 10 & 24 [1766933214480]
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is Siliah Sittah?","marks":1,"answer":"In the third Hijri century, the six most authentic Hadith books were compiled which is known as Siliah Sittah."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"\"The Hadith is the explanation of the Al-Quran.\" Explain it.","marks":2,"answer":"The principles mentioned in the Holy Quran are explained in details in Hadith, this is called the explanation of Al-Quran. Allah the Most High has described many instructions, rules and regulations briefly in the Holy Quran. Prophet (Sm), by the instruction of Allah, explained these clearly. That is, in Hadith, clear description of Quran is provided."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Which Surah's teachings are reflected in the character of Mr. 'M'? Explain.","marks":3,"answer":"In the character of Mr. 'M' the teaching of Sura Al-Maun is expressed. Sura Al-Maun is the 107th sura of Al-Quran. Allah has described some characteristics of Munafiqs in it and encouraged in helping orphans, destitutes, needy. Alongside, He also forbade to pray for showing others. All of which are observed in the character of Mr. M. In the stem he behaves kindly with orphans, poors and relatives with the expectations of reward in Akhirat. He does not like making a show in the Ibadat of Allah. Such activities of him, the teachings of Sura Al-Maun is expressed. Because in Sura Al-Maun, Allah says that, the orphans and distressed are not to be warded off, rather they should be helped and supported as far as possible. Besides, the members of the family, friends and comrades, neighbours and all are encouraged in this matter. On the other side, about Salat, it is told that, Salat must not be neglected on any context. Salat should not be prayed for making a show. Rather Salat should be performed with the purest intention only for the pleasure of Allah the Most High. That is why, it can be said that, in the character of Mr. M, the teachings of Sura Al-Maun is expressed."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Analyse the accuracy of the statement of the respected Imam, about the earnings of Mr. 'N'.","marks":4,"answer":"The statement of the respected Imam about Haram earning of Mr. 'N' is accurate. Haram is opposite to Halal. Those actions or things which Allah the Most High and His Rasul (Sm) have clearly forbidden—all those are Haram for man. For instance, usury, bribery, gambling, eating pig meat, drinking wine etc. And the money earning through these Haram things are also considered as haram earning which is noticeable in the earnings of Mr. 'N'. Mr. 'N' of the stem earned a lot of money by doing business of narcotics and leads a luxurious life. After learning about his earnings, respected Imam said, \"The consequences of this type of earnings are very horrible in here and here after life\". Here, the statement of the Imam regarding haram earning is proper. Haram activities exert harmful influence on human society. Due to this, social environment deteriorates, moral, human value are destroyed.; disparity surfaces in the society. And those who are engaged in such Haram activities, are hated by all in the society. Alongside this, there is frightening consequences for them in the life hereafter. Rasul (Sm) said, \"That body (human) which is formed on Haram, will be the fuel of Hell\" (Ahmad, Baihadj and Darimi). Lastly, it can be said that, for earning through Haram objects, the earnings of Mr. 'N' is haram. And the statement of the respected Imam about this is accurate.\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question:
Mr. Sajid is a wealthy person. He was negligent about saying his prayers. Once, he was taking his tea on a Friday morning. That time an orphaned beggar asked him for some alms. He got angry and chased him away. On the other hand, Mr. Ramiz became frustrated as his son failed the S.S.C exam and as his friends started to make fun of him. His neighbour Mr. Aman asked him to have patience. He also said, there will be sadness and happiness in human life.
Lessons 8 & 10 [1766933214970]
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is Shariat?","marks":1,"answer":"Shariat is such a clear and distinct path by following which man can safely and gracefully reach his own destination."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Explain the importance of reciting the Quran.","marks":2,"answer":"To attain success both in this life and hereafter and to lead one's life on the correct path, reciting the Quran is essential. Al Quran is the sacred sayings of Allah. This is the complete storehouse of knowledge. Correct guidance of all aspects of human lives has been given in the Quran. It is the best form of Ibadat. Reciting one of its letters brings in a ten-fold reward. The Quran enhances the dignity of the reciter. For these reasons, reciting the Quran is immensely important."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"The teaching of which sura has been violated by the activities of Mr. Sajid? Explain it.","marks":3,"answer":"The activities of Mr. Sajid violated the teachings of Sura Al-Maun. Sura Al Maun described the features and activities of the Kafirs and the Munafiqs and asked men to avoid them. Sajid didn't follow this teaching. Mr. Sajid is indifferent towards saying his prayers. He also chases away the orphaned beggars who request him for alms. But in Sura Maun, we can see that this is the activity of the Kafir and the Munafiqs to chase away the orphans and be rude to them rather than extend a helping hand towards them. Another feature of the Munafiq is that they do not say their prayers regularly. They are indifferent towards Salat. For these activities, there will be destruction in Akhirat. That's why rather than chasing away the destitute and the orphans, they must be helped. Salat can never be neglected. Thus we can see that the activities of Mr. Sajid violated the teachings of the sura Al-Maun."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Mentioning the Sura whose teaching has been reflected in Mr. Aman's speech, analyse his last statement.","marks":4,"answer":"The statement of Mr. Aman reflected the teachings of Sura Al-Inshirah. Sura Al-Inshirah is the 94th Sura of Al-Quran. In this Sura, Allah described his rewards for the Prophet (Sm.). Allah has also instructed the prophet what to do in times of crisis. Mr. Aman's statement supports these. Mr. Aman asks his neighbours to have patience in times of distress. According to him there will be ups and downs in life and the truth of this statement can be seen in Sura Al-Inshirah. When the Prophet started preaching Islam among the Arabs, the Kafirs started protesting against him. The prophet and the new Muslims were tortured. This distressed the prophet. In this situation Allah consoled the prophet and said, after sorrow, there will be happiness. As sadness will always be there, we can't be frustrated. Rather we have to deal with it with patience. That's why rather than becoming distressed in the face of hardship, one must concentrate on worshipping Allah. From the above discussion, it can be understood that the statement of Aman was influenced by the teaching of sura Al-Inshirah. His last statement in this regard is accurate."}]
